title: Gaussian accelerated molecular dynamics simulations reveal inhibitor-dependent loop dynamics in aminopeptidase N.
authors: Yu, Shuang; Wang, Jinhong; Zhao, Yi; Zhuo, Xinlan; Li, Xiang; Liang, Guizhao
one_liner_zh: 该文用高斯加速分子动力学模拟研究氨肽酶N在不同抑制剂作用下的构象动态差异，属于蛋白质构象采样与抑制剂结合机制的计算研究，与课题高度相关。
abstract: Aminopeptidase N (APN) is a critical exopeptidase that plays key roles in physiological processes such as tumor metastasis, immune regulation, and viral infections. However, the conformational dynamics associated with different APN inhibitors remain insufficiently understood, particularly whether inhibitors with varying potency induce similar or distinct dynamic behaviors. Here, we applied Gaussian accelerated molecular dynamics (GaMD) simulations to investigate the conformational effects of three representative APN inhibitors, Bestatin, CHR-79888, and Kelatorphan, revealing inhibitor-dependent differences in APN conformational dynamics. The results showed that, in the CHR-79888- and Kelatorphan-bound systems, the flexible loop (891)YGGGSFSF(898) preferentially sampled distinct conformations and formed more frequent direct contacts with the ligands. These systems also exhibited tighter interdomain coupling around the active site and shorter, more distributed residue communication pathways, consistent with a more restricted and coordinated conformational ensemble. In contrast, the Bestatin-bound system exhibited fewer direct contacts between the ligand and the flexible loop, together with larger conformational fluctuations and less coordinated interdomain communication. Overall, our study reveals the inhibitor-dependent unique loop dynamics of APN, providing new theoretical insights for the design of efficient APN inhibitors.
abstract_zh: 氨肽酶N（Aminopeptidase N, APN）是一种关键的肽链外切酶，在肿瘤转移、免疫调节和病毒感染等生理过程中发挥重要作用。然而，与不同APN抑制剂相关的构象动态仍未被充分理解，特别是具有不同效力的抑制剂是否诱导相似或不同的动态行为。在此，我们应用高斯加速分子动力学（Gaussian accelerated molecular dynamics, GaMD）模拟来研究三种代表性APN抑制剂——贝他汀（Bestatin）、CHR-79888和凯拉托芬（Kelatorphan）——的构象效应，揭示了APN构象动态中依赖抑制剂的差异。结果表明，在CHR-79888和凯拉托芬结合的系统中，柔性环(891)YGGGSFSF(898)优先采样不同的构象，并与配体形成更频繁的直接接触。这些系统还表现出活性位点周围更紧密的结构域间耦合，以及更短、更分散的残基通讯路径，这与更受限且协调的构象集合一致。相比之下，贝他汀结合的系统中，配体与柔性环之间的直接接触较少，同时伴随更大的构象波动和较不协调的结构域间通讯。总体而言，我们的研究揭示了APN中依赖抑制剂的独特环动态，为高效APN抑制剂的设计提供了新的理论见解。
